# ankra_application_ai_config (Resource)

Per-application overrides of the organisation's Ankra AI lanes: which lanes run on the application's repository, on which model and under which budget. The counterpart of `ankra application ai-config set`. Only the lanes listed in `lanes` are managed; each one listed replaces that lane's override wholesale, and a field left unset inherits from the organisation. Removing a lane, or destroying the resource, returns it to the organisation default. The application's repository must be reachable through the Ankra GitHub App.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_application_ai_config" "web" {
  application_id = ankra_application.web.id

  lanes = {
    pull_request = {
      enabled          = true
      autonomy         = "propose_fix"
      branches         = ["main"]
      max_runs_per_day = 50
    }
    previews = {
      enabled = true
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Identifier of the application. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `lanes` (Attributes Map) Lane overrides keyed by lane: `pull_request`, `code`, `actions`, `skills` or `previews`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lanes))

### Read-Only

- `repo_full_name` (String) Repository the lanes are configured on, as `owner/name`.

<a id="nestedatt--lanes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lanes`

Optional:

- `autonomy` (String) `comment` or `propose_fix`.
- `branches` (List of String) Branches the lane runs on; empty means every branch.
- `custom_instructions` (String) Review guidance appended to the lane's prompt.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the lane runs on this application. Unset follows the organisation.
- `ignore_paths` (List of String) Path globs the lane ignores. An empty list clears the platform's default list.
- `max_input_characters` (Number) Input characters one run may send; 0 is no cap.
- `max_reviews_per_pull_request` (Number) Automatic reviews one pull request may receive; 0 is no cap.
- `max_runs_per_day` (Number) Runs per day the lane may start; 0 is no cap.
- `model` (String) Model the lane runs on.
- `skill_ids` (List of String) Skills the lane uses.
- `skip_drafts` (Boolean) Whether draft pull requests are skipped.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by application id.
terraform import ankra_application_ai_config.web 5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10
```
